meta.description: 5-question check-in, about 30 seconds. Answers go to the on-board assessment input only; they are not readings and never change the tier (D13).

questions.text: How is your mood right now?
How many hours did you sleep last night?
How easy is it to focus?

flags.message: Mood is lower than usual. Try the breathing exercise.
flags.source: DESIGN_CHOICE, same limit as knowledge.json mood amber (at_or_below 3)

flags.message: Less than 7 hours of sleep. Protect your next sleep period.
Stress is high. Try the breathing exercise.
Focus is hard. Avoid safety-critical tasks until you feel better.
Tell your crew medical officer about this symptom.

overall.label: Check in with your crew medical officer

scoring.never_red: Self-report alone never makes red (knowledge.json mood note).
